TTD-34022(31)/250/2023-PROCURMENT SEC-TTD In this regard, in order check the quality of Ghee supplied by the firm M/s A R Dairy Food Private Limited, 3(Three) samples were collected on 12.07.2024 from the consignment supplied by the firm to TTD through the tanker bearing no. TN02 BB 2151 at Tirumala and one sample was sent to laboratory of NDDB (National Dairy Development Board) CALF (Centre for Analysis and learning in Livestock & Food), which is a multidisciplinary analytical laboratory at NDDB Anand, Gujarat. CALF has been accredited as per the ISO/IEC 17025 by the National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL) in 2013 for chemical and biological testing. Biological scope covers both microbiology and genetics testing. The remaining two samples were kept at TTD lab and warehouse for further reference. In this regard, it is to inform that it is the prime responsibility of the supplier to adhere to the terms and conditions of the agreement invariably before delivery of the materials. The conditions which elaborated in respect of the various standard specifications and in case of breach of the contract are detailed below for reference. As per **clause.10** of agreement, it is stated that i) “The supply of cow ghee is meant for preparation of the sacred prasadams of Lord Venkateswara swamy and every care should be taken by the supplier to see that there is no variation in the quality of supply. Each supply will be accepted subject to Lab Test only.” ii) Vide clause. 23 of agreement “The supply of Cow Ghee with Agmark Special grade should strictly conform to the following specifications.” *Table -1*
